prompt_spec: Six masonry wall components in source order. Keep all wall heights consistent. North-wall components have their long run across X: front and rear are broad faces, right and left are thin end profiles, top and bottom are narrow cap strips. For west-wall components, follow world axes: their long plan run extends Y, so front and rear show thin wall edges while right and left show broad vertical wall faces. Outer and inner corner views follow joined wall footprint; top is plan view, bottom is structural footprint underside. Endcaps have narrow cap top and bottom, do not show front face as cap.
